_comment: Contract generation and valuation settings. Controls how contracts are structured based on player quality, age, and market conditions.

age_multipliers._comment: Age impact on contract value. Peak years (25-27) = 1.0. Young players get slight discount for inexperience, older players get discounts for declining skills.
age_multipliers._22_comment: Age 22 - rookie/second year, still developing (15% discount)
age_multipliers._34+_comment: Age 34+ - late career, high injury risk (60% discount)

contract_lengths._comment: Typical contract lengths by player quality. Elite players get longer deals with more security, backups get short-term contracts.

elite._comment: Elite players (90+ rating): Long-term deals to lock up franchise cornerstones

starter._comment: Quality starters (75-89 rating): Multi-year deals with team control

backup._comment: Backup quality (60-74 rating): Short-term depth contracts

minimum._comment: Below replacement level (<60 rating): Year-to-year minimum deals

guarantees._comment: Guaranteed money percentage by player tier. Elite players get more security, backups get minimal guarantees.
guarantees._minimum_comment: Minimum contracts: 10% guaranteed (minimal risk for team)

rookie_scale._comment: Rookie contract values by draft pick. Overrides market value calculations for drafted players. All rookie deals are 4 years.
rookie_scale._enabled_comment: When true, drafted players use rookie scale instead of market value
rookie_scale._round_1_apy_comment: Round 1 picks: $8M average per year (top talent, premium compensation)
rookie_scale._round_2_apy_comment: Round 2 picks: $3M average per year (solid value picks)
rookie_scale._round_3_apy_comment: Round 3 picks: $1.5M average per year (developmental players)
rookie_scale._round_4_apy_comment: Round 4 picks: $1M average per year (depth and competition)
rookie_scale._round_5_apy_comment: Round 5 picks: $800K average per year (long shots)
rookie_scale._round_6_apy_comment: Round 6 picks: $700K average per year (practice squad candidates)
rookie_scale._round_7_apy_comment: Round 7 picks: $600K average per year (minimum salary range)
rookie_scale._years_comment: All rookie contracts are 4 years (with 5th year option for round 1 picks - not yet implemented)

_eval_source_comment: Source of evaluation scores for contract valuation (composite 0-100 score)

base_range_curve._comment: Base contract value ranges by evaluation score. Used as foundation before position/age/market adjustments.

ranges._comment: Poor quality (0-39.9): Below replacement level, minimum contracts
Below average (40-54.9): Practice squad to roster bubble
Average (55-69.9): Backup to fringe starter quality

position_tiers._comment: Position groupings for contract valuation. Premium positions get paid more than core positions.
position_tiers._premium_comment: Premium positions: highest paid due to scarcity and impact
position_tiers._core_comment: Core positions: solid contributors, moderate pay
position_tiers._specialist_comment: Specialists: lowest paid, limited impact on wins

position_weights._comment: Position multipliers for contract value. Applied after base value calculation.
position_weights._EDGE_comment: Edge rushers get 25% premium (elite pass rushers are game-changers)
position_weights._CB_comment: Cornerbacks get 20% premium (critical in pass-heavy league)
position_weights._OL_comment: Offensive line gets 5% premium (foundational but undervalued)
position_weights._DL_comment: Defensive line gets 5% premium (run defense anchor)
position_weights._S_comment: Safeties get 5% discount (less valued than CBs)
position_weights._TE_comment: Tight ends get 5% discount (hybrid role, limited impact)
position_weights._RB_comment: Running backs get 10% discount (replaceable in modern NFL)

potential_delta._comment: Adjustments for young players with high potential vs current performance
potential_delta._use_position_core_stats_comment: When true, only use position-relevant stats for potential calculation
potential_delta._young_age_max_comment: Players 22 and under are considered 'young' for potential bonus
potential_delta._old_age_min_comment: Players 28+ are considered 'old' for potential penalty

weight_curve._comment: Age 18: Heavy weight on potential (prospects with lots of room to grow)
Age 22: Moderate weight on potential (young players still developing)
Age 26: Light weight on potential (prime years, mostly developed)
Age 30+: Minimal weight on potential (veterans are what they are)

potential_delta._delta_scale_comment: How much potential difference affects value (0.60 = 60% of difference)
potential_delta._max_bonus_pct_comment: Maximum upside bonus for high-potential young players (20% boost)
potential_delta._max_penalty_pct_comment: Maximum downside penalty for low-potential veterans (15% reduction)

range_spread._comment: Contract negotiation range around estimated value

range_jitter._comment: Optional randomization of contract ranges for realism
range_jitter._enabled_comment: When true, adds small random variation to contract ranges
range_jitter._rng_source_comment: RNG must be passed in for determinism

_currency_unit_comment: Unit of currency for all contract values (abstract cap units, not real dollars)
